title: helianthemum guttatum var. punctatum
intro: Helianthemum guttatum var. punctatum, commonly known as Rockrose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Cistaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, and improving wound healing. The health benefits of Rockrose include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been associated with the therapeutic actions of reducing fever and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
